implementation_status: Untrained context-aware interval decoder, fit-only normalization and physical objective pass CPU checks. CUDA next-update restoration/timing and scientific acceptance remain untested.
partition_limitation: Frozen GRU was previously trained on both decoder-fit and decoder-selection, and fixed feature/state normalization uses former TRAIN. Selection is therefore head-level transfer selection, not an end-to-end independent GRU holdout. Confirmation excludes GRU/head training and current head checkpoint selection, but its outcomes were examined in earlier development experiments and are not pristine. The base GRU checkpoint was itself selected on this former validation set; this is not an untouched complete-pipeline holdout.

training.device: Cloud CUDA only; no local optimizer
training.case_order: Matched deterministic permutations of decoder-fit histories only, seed3620+epoch. Keep per-configuration replica weights; all replicas stay in one role.
training.origin_mix: For each fit history each epoch, deterministic independent50%choice of full-origin0trajectory90steps or rolling16trajectory with origin uniform0..74. Same choices/permutation across arms. Decode each real forecast length before concatenating/padding prediction tensors for the joint loss; never evaluate a decoder on artificial feature padding. Use strict valid masks and length normalization; padded values must not affect loss.
training.state_loss: encoded_control retains joint02 objective/activity definition. physical_primary uses fit-baseline-normalized physical MAE surrogate:25%full autonomous+75%exactdisplay under50%full/50%rolling sampling; rolling physical MAE uses only final16thtarget. Perfullcase weight0.5full90MAE/autonomousbaseline +0.25first15MAE/displaybaseline; perrollingcase1.25endpointMAE/displaybaseline. Four outputs equal after their own baseline-MAE normalization. Inverse replica weights normalized within batch.
training.extras: Primary adds0.25pointwise positive encoded squared-error deterioration over rawbase, normalized by fit baseline original objective; log1p pointwise quiet absolute-error deterioration beyond0.001physical encoding scale, normalized by that slack; and previous0.1underCVaR,0.05overCVaR,0.05peak,0.1sampling-residual terms. Quiet penalty uses scoredpointlabels0 and full90/rollingendpoint. This is stronger than aggregate quiet guard and is soft, not a guarantee. encoded_control keeps all old joint02loss terms.
training.sampling_residual: Compare predicted minus TRUE trajectory residual: trapezoid(endpoint gas)/0.75 minus predicted dry-mass loss. Normalize by initial dry mass. Target residual is not forced zero because endpoint samples and cumulative labels differ.
training.initial_states: Both arms use identical seed3630untrained context interval decoder bytes; untrained projection is distinct from rawGRU fallback(epoch-1). Neither is claimed trained improvement.
training.resume: Fresh independent AdamW state for each new head. Before fitting each arm, CUDA next-update replay must be bitwise after a nonempty optimizer/RNG snapshot/restore. Checkpoint every epoch and batch-boundary deadline with model, optimizer, RNG, current case permutation, origin choices, epoch/batch cursor, history and selected state.

evaluation.phase_reporting: Use existing ScorecardV1 phase definitions and report numerators/denominators for evaluated forecasts, including weak/transition cases. Primary rolling16steps is approximately32seconds, not the canonical16-second headline. Full canonical scorecard/all-horizon replay is still required after an accepted candidate. No-change is a diagnostic comparator in both regimes.
evaluation.head_selection: Use only326configuration/330history decoder-selection role for checkpoint/winner selection. GRU was trained on that role, so this is head-level development selection. Never inspect confirmation metrics mid-run.
evaluation.eligible: Original raw GRU fallback, each untrained arm epoch0, and every10completed epochs. A candidate is guarded if original objective/state MAEs/integral/peak-time/sampling-consistency/overprediction tail are within5%baseline on full autonomous forecasts, quiet increases<=0.001physical encoding scales in both regimes, and display objective/state MAEs within5%. No requirement for a stitched display curve to obey a single physical trajectory.
evaluation.checkpoint_rule: Prefer checkpoints passing ALL acceptance checks on selection data; among those minimize maximum of four DISPLAY state-MAE ratios to raw GRU, then mean ratio, then startup deficit, then original autonomous objective, then earlier epoch. If none passes, retain the best guarded exploratory checkpoint by the same key or raw fallback. Store accepted_on_selection separately; a fallback is not an improvement.
evaluation.winner_rule: Only selection-accepted arms eligible; same frozen rank. Stable final tie uses encoded_control then physical_primary. Freeze both checkpoints and winner before confirmation. Comparing objective arms uses identical architecture, initialization and case/origin draws. Comparing with joint02 also changes architecture/initialization and is not an isolated causal test of lead.
evaluation.confirmation: Only after selection-freeze artifact is saved, evaluate raw baseline, both untrained arms and both selected arms on210histories/204configurations from former validation. Judge only the already frozen winner; do not switch winner using confirmation results. This set influenced older experiments and base checkpoint selection, so report development confirmation, not pristine independent generalization.
evaluation.test: Original test features/evaluation excluded from this trial. If confirmation passes, a separately frozen inference/gallery replay is still required before declaring the known displayed prediction problem repaired.

acceptance.invalid_state_reporting: Report negatives, initial-mass exceedances and increases within each individual forecast. Stitched display jumps are forecast revisions. Tiny negative observed water is explicitly projected only in interval decoding. Heating index stays signed.

budget_plan.scope: Single bounded CUDA run after live budget/inventory/package checks; no automatic retry. Existing Flex40USD unchanged. Both300epoch comparisons must complete; otherwise checkpoint and report incomplete.

scope: Untrained context-aware interval output correction over a frozen GRU. The 51 head inputs comprise 46 existing features, four observed origin states, and known forecast lead. Corrected outputs do not feed recurrent dynamics. Same data roles and all joint02 accuracy acceptance rules, raw fallback, exact gallery/autonomous regimes, development-confirmation limitations, and original-test exclusion. Simplified simulation scope remains 3 m diameter conical crowns, 0.5 m mesh, imposed 1500 C contact ignition for 20 seconds, and no embers, trunks or buildings. Improved agreement would not validate realistic vegetation or wildfire physics.
